_note: What you see: The information page about reporting absence: online or by phone, the table what you report how, leave via the head teacher and what the school does about absenteeism.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De informatiepagina over afwezig melden: online of bellen, de tabel wat meldt u hoe, verlof bij de directeur en wat de school doet bij verzuim.
Is uw kind ziek, of moet het naar de dok: Is your child ill, or due at the doctor or the dentist? Report it before half past eight. The teacher sees your report straight away in class.
Het snelst. U logt in met DigiD, kiest u: The fastest. You sign in with DigiD, choose your child and the day, and you are done. Afterwards you see whether the teacher has seen it.
You can on school days between 8.00 and 8.30. The office then enters your report in the system for you.
Afwezig melden. Elke dag opnieuw, of in: Report absence. Each day again, or in one go for several days
Een dag van tevoren als dat kan: A day ahead if you can
Niets. De leerkracht schrijft het op: Nothing. The teacher writes it down
Children from age 5 are in compulsory education. Time off outside the school holidays is only allowed for a special reason, such as a wedding or a funeral in the family. Holidays outside the school holidays are almost never allowed.
U vraagt verlof aan bij de directeur, Ha: You request leave from the head teacher, Hanneke Postma. She decides within five school days. If you disagree with the decision, the school guide tells you what you can do.
Is uw kind afwezig zonder melding? Dan b: Is your child absent without a report? Then the teacher calls you the same morning. If your child stays away more often without reason, the school must report it to the attendance officer of Zuiddrecht.
